summary: boot_loader.py loads 5 context fields (person_profile, last_session, epoch_state, companion_state, live_context). all 5 influence any_loaded (memory_source='storage' detection). but _check_memory_source() in init_airlock.py builds prior_context with only 4 keys — companion_state and live_context are silently dropped. consequence: if only companion_state_v1.json exists in storage, packet reports memory_source='storage' but prior_context contains only None values. misleading signal to downstream consumers. probe-confirmed.
evidence: boot_loader.py:27-33 — any_loaded uses all 5: person_profile, last_session, epoch_state, companion_state, live_context
init_airlock.py:96-101 — prior dict only has: loaded_from, last_session, epoch_state, person_profile
probe result: storage with only companion_state_v1.json → memory_source='storage', all prior_context values None
no test in helen_os/tests/test_init_airlock.py covers companion_state or live_context drop (224-line file, grep: 0 hits)
hypothesis: If companion_state or live_context is the only populated storage file, memory_source='storage' but prior_context carries all-None values — a phantom storage signal that cannot carry any continuity to the session.
proposed_tweak: Add companion_state and live_context to the prior dict in _check_memory_source() (init_airlock.py:96-101). One dict expansion, two lines. No schema change needed — ContextPacket.prior_context is dict[str, Any].
metric: Probe: tmp dir with only companion_state_v1.json; assert prior_context['companion_state'] == {'companion_id': 'C1', 'mood': 'curious'} after fix.
keep_rule: KEEP if prior_context['companion_state'] propagates correctly and no test regression; REJECT if ContextPacket consumers break on unexpected keys.
next: Add test: storage_with_companion_only → prior_context['companion_state'] not None; apply fix to init_airlock.py:96-101; re-run make test.
risk_flags: Low structural risk — ContextPacket.prior_context is untyped dict, consumers should tolerate new keys
Medium semantic risk — downstream LLM or router may treat all-None prior_context as 'fresh session' when companion_state data exists
